34/G.goal: Explain the Majuli Island VR heritage preservation case study and the key challenges of building an immersive, interactive tour from its multimodal heritage archive.
34/G.achieves: Equips the learner with the case-study foundation needed to understand and implement an XR system through its development stages.

34/O1.goal: Describe the overall context and data foundation of the Majuli Island VR heritage preservation case study.
34/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a shared reference case and its heritage-data scope for the later requirement gathering, design, and implementation stages of the course.

34/O2.goal: Identify the key challenges in building an immersive, interactive Majuli VR tour from the multimodal heritage archive.
34/O2.achieves: Prepares the learner to anticipate and address the experiential, usability, and technical issues discussed in the subsequent case-study lectures.
